title: Retro Computing
content: Apply retro computing aesthetic with vintage computer feel. CRT monitor effects: scan lines, phosphor glow, slight curvature. DOS/mainframe color schemes: amber or green on black, blue BIOS screens. Blocky bitmap fonts. Command prompt interfaces. Floppy disk and tape references. Blinking cursor. System boot sequences. BASIC code appearance. Mainframe operator atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create vintage computing aesthetic with CRT monitors, DOS prompts, and mainframe terminal styling.

variants.advanced: Apply retro computing aesthetic with vintage mainframe/personal computer feel. CRT effects: scan lines (horizontal lines via repeating-linear-gradient), phosphor glow (text-shadow with color spread), screen curvature (slight barrel distortion via CSS transform), color bleeding between adjacent pixels. Classic terminals: VT100 green (#33ff33) on black, IBM amber (#ffb000), blue mainframe screens (#4169e1 on black). Screen noise: subtle static/noise overlay, occasional flicker. Bitmap fonts: DOS fonts (Perfect DOS VGA), C64, Apple II - chunky pixels, no anti-aliasing (font-smooth: never). Boot sequences: POST text, memory counting, BIOS splash screens, loading dots. Command prompts: C:> or $ prompts, directory listings, FORMAT warnings. Error screens: BSOD styling (white on blue), Guru Meditation (Amiga red), Sad Mac. Loading: spinning cursor, percentage bars with blocks █░░░. BASIC code: line numbers (10, 20, 30), keywords in caps, READY prompt. Floppy/tape: 3.5" disk icons, loading from tape visualization, A: drive references. Sound suggested: beeps, disk drive sounds, modem handshake. Hardware: keyboard styling (chunky keys), CRT monitor bezels. Startup chime: visual representation of boot sounds. Memory: conventional/extended memory displays, 640K messages. Window managers: Windows 3.1, Mac System 7 styled elements. Implementation: CSS filters for CRT effects, custom fonts. Accessibility: retro effects can reduce readability - ensure content is accessible, motion respects preferences.
